@syntax Case value
@syntax Case value1, value2, ...
A part of [Select](Select): the statements after it run when the selected expression equals one of the listed values. Several values are separated with commas.

```blitzbasic
;run
s$ = "b"
Select s$
	Case "a"
		Print "A"
	Case "b", "c"
		Print "B or C"
End Select
```

```text
B or C
```
